audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is described as pure poke pressure with no mechanical out.
audit.why: Piercing Light is target-based ('shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target'), so Hallowed Mist makes Gwen untargetable to a Lucian standing outside it. That is the concrete early-lane answer the text never gives.
audit.corrected: Early is his, but from Level 4 the mist blanks Piercing Light and his autos unless he steps in.

audit.why: Spikes read Lucian levels 1-3, Gwen 6 / Riftmaker / two items. That matches the 52.48% Emerald+ rate over 848 games and Gwen's %max-HP scaling against a 1400-range squishy.

audit.whatIsWrong: Never states that Piercing Light requires a target, never gives Relentless Pursuit's real cooldown, never mentions the Lightslinger auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 and is shortened by every Lightslinger attack, so tracking it by stopwatch is wrong — you count his autos. Lightslinger is an attack reset, so the wind-up is the commit tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Mist blanks his target-based Q; count Lightslinger hits, not seconds, to know when his dash is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block treats Relentless Pursuit as a fixed timer.
audit.why: Its cooldown is reduced by Lightslinger attacks, so a flat count misleads.

edits.after: Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot and Piercing Light chunk you at every last-hit, and with no W or E yet you cannot answer — his strongest window. Last-hit from max range and give up the caster minions.
Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it: Piercing Light needs a target, so from outside the mist he gets nothing — he must step in, and then you slow-chase a flashless Lucian.
Drop Hallowed Mist and hold its centre — Piercing Light and his autos both need a target, so from outside it he gets nothing
Step into the mist only to shoot, then Relentless Pursuit straight out — its 16s drops fast off Lightslinger hits
Lightslinger's double-shot is an attack reset — his wind-up, not the cast, is your cue to step out of Piercing Light.
Base 16s, but every Lightslinger hit cuts it. Commit right after he burns it.
Trade outside mist while Relentless Pursuit is up

- Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger hit shortens it — count his autos, not the clock. - Hallowed Mist (22s at rank 1): spend it to blank Piercing Light, which needs a target. - Needlework: kill windows only.
Stack passive on minions, E in with the center-Q ready, snip the true-damage core, and W on top of him if he turns.

notes: Content win[] and full phases[].side both read Lucian at Level 6 and 2+ items while the prose (spikes, whys[4-6], late) says Gwen takes those stages outright; the scratchpad packet levelChart says Gwen at 5/6/7. Left the arrays alone rather than invent a shift — see questionsForUser.
